/work/vellor-residency.title: Vellor Residency - My Framer Site
/work/vellor-residency.description: Belgrade-based Creative Director specializing in brand identity, art direction, and visual storytelling. Portfolio of selected works across branding, print, and digital.
p: Vellor Residency is a contemporary residential development designed for modern urban living — a gated complex offering luxury apartments, private amenities, and rooftop penthouses, set for completion in 2028. The brief called for a brand identity that communicates architectural clarity, long-term value, and structural reliability — appealing equally to future residents and investors. The resulting visual system draws from a restrained palette of Gunmetal, Cadet Grey, and Light Blue, paired with Proxima Nova to balance authority with approachability. From construction signage and outdoor advertising to sales materials and digital presence, every touchpoint was crafted to position Vellor as more than a place to live — as a statement of intent.

p: Nordarch Studio is a Belgrade-based architecture firm with a Nordic design philosophy — where structure meets restraint. The brief called for a visual identity that communicates authority, precision, and timelessness. The resulting brand system draws from raw textures, muted tones, and tight typographic hierarchy — reflecting the studio's approach to space and form. Every touchpoint, from business cards to digital presence, was crafted to feel intentional and enduring. The identity positions Nordarch as a studio that doesn't follow trends — it defines them.

/work/falco-gin.title: Falco Gin - My Framer Site
/work/falco-gin.description: Belgrade-based Creative Director specializing in brand identity, art direction, and visual storytelling. Portfolio of selected works across branding, print, and digital.
p: Falco Gin is a handcrafted Swiss premium spirit defined by character, precision, and a bold sensory identity. Distilled in small batches and refined with a unique blend of botanicals and exotic fruits, the brand balances tradition with a contemporary edge. This project focused on translating that identity into a tactile, editorial experience. Through art direction and booklet design, the goal was to create a visual narrative that reflects the essence of Falco — raw, refined, and unapologetically expressive.
